RaggieSoft is Not Hiring

Official Corporate Notice Regarding Fraudulent Employment Offers

If you have received an email, direct message, or text claiming to offer employment, an interview, or a freelance contract with RaggieSoft or RaggieSoft Media, you are communicating with a scammer.

RaggieSoft is a privately held, single-person creative portfolio. We operate with zero external staff. We do not have a Human Resources department, we do not utilize third-party recruiters, and we will never offer you a job.

Common Red Flags in this Scam:

  • You were contacted out of the blue on platforms like Upwork, LinkedIn, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
  • You are being asked to complete a "remote data entry" or "customer service" questionnaire via text or email.
  • You are being asked to purchase your own home-office equipment with the promise that RaggieSoft will "reimburse" you or send you a check. (The check will bounce, and your money will be gone).
  • The sender is using a spoofed email address that looks similar to our corporate domain.

Next Steps to Protect Yourself

1. Cease all communication with the fraudulent party immediately. Do not attempt to confront them.
2. Do not deposit any checks they send you, and do not provide them with your banking routing numbers or social security information.
3. Report the fraudulent listing to the platform where you found it (e.g., LinkedIn, Indeed, Upwork).

Report to FBI (IC3) Report to FTC
